notes.title: Build For Sale Simulator Major Update
notes.notes:
🏦 Banking System
A new Bank tab has been added to the tablet!

Track your daily and monthly income/expenses.

Review your transaction history to see all past actions.

Take loans to purchase more properties and grow faster.

💡 Financial planning and expansion are now in your hands! 

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712624/f2e8b764f6f35ca0829733eed8d458435d9cd167.png"]
[hr][/hr]

🎨 Default Graphics Settings
The game now launches with high graphic settings and LUMEN enabled, delivering a much more realistic experience.

If you experience performance issues, you can easily adjust the settings from the Settings Menu.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712624/b19ba94c308800a0b4e9bae25b566dee25db021b.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712624/a5bcb3ba8f130abf3745f50c4718688ba73bd163.png"]
[hr][/hr]

🐞 Bug Fixes
✅ Fixed continuous rain issue.

✅ Fixed characters disappearing during rainy weather.

✅ Fixed ESC key not working properly in UI navigation.

✅ Resolved various bugs when creating listings.


[hr][/hr]

🪑 New Item
Added Streamer Chair to the Streamer Setup category. 🎮🖥️

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712624/6e2342995dfe5a2408c6e32ffe3da7214f70fcb7.png"]
[hr][/hr]
Thank You! Your feedback is very important to us. Please report any bugs in the Discord channel or on Steam discussions. 💛

notes.title: 🛠️ Small Update – Auto Save + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Highlights

✅ Added Auto Save System – the game now saves progress automatically.

✅ Fixed Certificate acquisition bug.

✅ General bug fixes and improvements.

Details

Auto Save: Even if you forget to save manually, your progress will now be preserved.

Certificates: Fixed issue where players couldn’t obtain certificates after completing tasks.

Stability: Minor bug fixes and optimizations under the hood.

notes.title: 🛠️ Small Update – Basic Bargaining + Fixes
notes.notes:
Highlights

✅ Added a Basic Bargaining System.

✅ Fixed floating/levitating items issue.

✅ Resolved ESC not closing the Big Map problem.

✅ Fixed occasional texture loading issues.

Details

Bargaining: Simple offer–counteroffer flow in customer dialogue. This is v1; improvements will come with feedback.

Physics/Placement: Improved alignment/collision to prevent items from hovering.

UI/UX: ESC now properly closes the Big Map.

Graphics: Optimized texture streaming to prevent missing/failed loads.
